justifications.research.methodologyDepth: Competency framework emphasizes GCP, regulatory, and data management with only superficial coverage of study design and biostatistics.
justifications.research.publicationTrack: CCRC holders may appear as middle/acknowledged authors on trial papers but rarely as first/senior authors; no measurable independent publication track.
justifications.research.grantReadiness: Credential does not prepare holders to write or win K/R/F awards; coordinators support PI-led grants rather than lead them.
justifications.research.pathwayToIndependence: CCRC explicitly defines a coordinator (non-investigator) role; independence requires an additional doctoral degree.
justifications.research.interdisciplinaryFit: Coordinators interface across medicine, nursing, pharmacy, and increasingly rehab trials, giving moderate cross-disciplinary exposure.
justifications.research.efficiency: Exam-based certification with ~3,000 experience hours and modest fees (~$600); far more accessible than a PhD.
